purpose: Reliable per-slot run evidence with one final GitHub write, no aggregate heartbeat rewrites, and no automation self-disabling on persistence failures.

receipt_authority.post_cutover: The deterministic final per-slot receipt is authoritative run evidence. Legacy aggregate heartbeat files are not completeness authorities after cutover.
receipt_authority.retain_history: History is the set of individual final receipt files. Never reconstruct or rewrite prior receipts to append a new run.

write_protocol: Derive the nominal scheduled slot in Europe/Madrid and deterministic receipt path before scanning, but do not write a RUNNING receipt.
Perform the scan, coverage classification and ledger read/classification first.

At end write the complete final receipt in one GitHub operation. If the deterministic path does not exist, create it. If it already exists from an idempotent retry, fetch it and replace only that same slot using its current SHA.
If the final write fails, retry once. Do not switch back to aggregate heartbeat history and do not invent a receipt.
A receipt-write failure is receipt_persistence_status=FAILED. It does not retroactively mean the employer scan did not run.

Never disable, pause, delete or change the schedule of an automation because of receipt, ledger, config, source or GitHub write failures. Only an explicit user action may disable a radar/watchdog/audit.

scan_complete_requires: exact configured employer-ID coverage for radars/daily audit or completed watchdog checks for Safety Net
completion_semantics.receipt_persistence_is_separate: A scan may be COMPLETE with receipt_persistence_status=FAILED. Safety Net treats the missing receipt as an evidence/persistence gap and performs recovery after grace.
does_not_require: successful persistence of non-alert-critical ledger backfills

missing_receipt_recovery.safety_action: If a post-cutover final receipt is missing after grace, record RECEIPT_PERSISTENCE_GAP and recover the affected radar. If exact employer coverage cannot be reconstructed, re-scan the full configured 66 with up to 48h lookback.
missing_receipt_recovery.warning: Use RECEIPT PERSISTENCE WARNING for a scan known to have run but whose final receipt could not be written. Do not label it a source-health failure and do not disable the radar.
missing_receipt_recovery.after_successful_recovery: Record the gap as recovered evidence uncertainty so it is not re-warned forever, while preserving that the original final receipt was missing.

automation_liveness.rule: All Madrid radar, Safety Net and Daily Audit automations must remain enabled across transient GitHub/source/state failures. Never call disable/pause on themselves.

fresh_radars_immediate_write_required_fo: qualifying fresh new requisition that is or will be alerted
Alerted=true persistence for a qualifying fresh alert
material state change needed to prevent immediate duplicate-alert inconsistency
do_not_require_immediate_write_for: newly observed requisition already outside the radar freshness window
old nonqualifying inventory discovered during a scan
canonical URL correction with no alert consequence
ledger_backfill_policy.noncritical_handling: Store as ledger_backfill_candidates for Safety Net/Daily Audit. Their mere presence does not make scan_status INCOMPLETE, does not trigger COVERAGE WARNING, and does not by itself set state_persistence_status=DEGRADED.
ledger_backfill_policy.critical_write_failure: Use state_persistence_status=CRITICAL and LEDGER STATE WARNING when fresh alert/new requisition/Alerted state cannot be safely persisted and immediate dedup/alert consistency is at risk.
